name: אִישְׁהוֹד
summary: A man of Manasseh, son of Hammolecheth the sister of Gilead, named once, with his brother Abiezer and Mahlah (1Ch 7:18). The name is אִישׁ “man of” and הוֹד “splendour, majesty”, on the pattern of אִישׁ חַיִל “man of worth” and אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה “man of war”: a man marked by splendour. הוֹד is said of Yahweh’s own majesty (Psa 104:1; 1Ch 29:11), so the name may mean a man of Yahweh’s splendour, but the text does not explain it.

evidence.note: “His sister Hammolecheth bore אִישְׁהוֹד and Abiezer and Mahlah.”
The line: Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh.
הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ, “you are clothed with splendour and majesty”.
“Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness and the might and the glory and the victory and הַהוֹד.”
The pattern: אִישׁ חַיִל, “a man of worth”.

note: One token (1Ch 7:18), written as one word in the text (אִישְׁהוֹד). The second element is the noun of the entry hod. Nothing else is said of him.
